components.name: Lamp housing
components.description: The traffic light: three lamps, one lit for the current air state.
components.css: .ds-light { background: var(--housing, #262b31); border-radius: 38px; padding: 14px; display: inline-grid; gap: 12px; justify-items: center; } .ds-lamp { width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--lamp-off, #3b4148); transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-lit-y { background: var(--y, #e3a008); box-shadow: 0 0 0 5px color-mix(in srgb, var(--y, #e3a008) 28%, transparent); }

components.name: Segment control
components.description: Range and language switch; neutral, the pressed segment is ink.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: inline-flex; height: 36px; border: 1px solid var(--line-ctl, #7d8692); border-radius: 9px; background: var(--panel, #fff); overflow: hidden; font-family: Lexend, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-seg button { font: inherit; color: var(--ink, #14181d); border: 0; background: none; padding: 0 14px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-seg button + button { border-left: 1px solid var(--line-ctl, #7d8692); } .ds-seg button:hover { background: var(--ground, #eceef1); } .ds-seg button[aria-pressed='true'] { background: var(--ink, #14181d); color: var(--panel, #fff); } .ds-seg button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink, #14181d); outline-offset: -4px; } .ds-seg button[aria-pressed='true']:focus-visible { outline-color: var(--panel, #fff); }

components.name: Theme button
components.description: 36px square control with a line icon; switches the colour scheme.
components.html: <button type="button" class="ds-icon-btn" aria-label="Dunkles Design einschalten"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 14.5A8 8 0 0 1 9.5 4a8 8 0 1 0 10.5 10.5z"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-icon-btn { width: 36px; height: 36px; display: grid; place-items: center; padding: 0; cursor: pointer; color: var(--ink, #14181d); background: var(--panel, #fff); border: 1px solid var(--line-ctl, #7d8692); border-radius: 9px; } .ds-icon-btn:hover { background: var(--ground, #eceef1); } .ds-icon-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink, #14181d); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-icon-btn svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; }

components.name: Value cells
components.description: Three fixed cells; the CO2 value takes the ink form of the lamp colour.
components.css: .ds-cells { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(170px, 210px)); border-top: 1px solid var(--line, #dde1e6); margin: 0; font-family: Lexend, system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--ink, #14181d); } .ds-cells > div { padding-top: 14px; } .ds-cells dt { font-size: 13px; color: var(--ink-3, #5c6570); } .ds-cells dd { margin: 0; } .ds-v { font-size: 34px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-u { font-size: 16px; color: var(--ink-3, #5c6570); margin-left: 4px; } .ds-soon { color: var(--y-ink, #855c00); }

components.name: Freshness line
components.description: Age of the readings; a neutral dot when live, an amber-ink triangle when outdated.
components.html:
Stand 10:42 · vor 12 s

Zuletzt 10:42
components.css: .ds-fresh { font-family: Lexend, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: var(--ink-3, #5c6570); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 20px; margin: 12px 0 0; } .ds-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--ink-3, #5c6570); flex: none; } .ds-stale { color: var(--ink, #14181d); } .ds-stale svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; color: var(--y-ink, #855c00); flex: none; }

components.name: Simulated tag
components.description: Identity line; the source word gets a dashed pill when readings are simulated.
components.css: .ds-ident { font-family: Lexend, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: var(--ink-3, #5c6570); display: flex; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin: 0; } .ds-tag { color: var(--ink, #14181d); border: 1px dashed var(--line-ctl, #7d8692); border-radius: 99px; padding: 0 8px; }

components.name: Chart panel
components.description: White panel with title, time window and a 340px ECharts canvas.
components.css: .ds-panel { background: var(--panel, #fff); border-radius: 14px; padding: 22px 26px 12px; font-family: Lexend, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--ink, #14181d); } .ds-panel h2 { font-size: 17px; font-weight: 700; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; gap: 4px 12px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin: 0; } .ds-win { font-weight: 400; color: var(--ink-3, #5c6570); font-size: 14px; } .ds-chart { height: 340px; margin-top: 8px; background: linear-gradient(to top, var(--g-band, rgba(31,157,85,0.08)) 40%, var(--y-band, rgba(227,160,8,0.14)) 40% 60%, var(--r-band, rgba(217,58,46,0.1)) 60%); }

narrative.overview:
A room's air state is a lit lamp, not a number to read. A dark housing holds three round lamps (red, amber, green). One lamp is lit, and one sentence next to it says what to do: "Luft gut", "Bald lüften", "Jetzt lüften". The charts carry the same lamps as background bands.

Everything else is matte and neutral: a cool grey ground, white panels, near-black ink. Colour means air state and nothing else. Controls stay grey. The page is dense but calm: one large room id, one status line, three fixed value cells, a freshness line, and two chart panels.

The layout refuses a wall of KPI tiles with sparklines. Values sit in fixed cells that keep their place and their width; only the content changes.
keyCharacteristics: One lit lamp per room; unlit lamps stay dark grey.
Colour only for air state; controls, text and the temperature line are ink.
Flat panels on a grey ground; no drop shadows.
Simulated data is dashed, never hidden.

rules.name: The Lamp-Only Colour Rule
rules.body: Green, amber and red appear only as the current air state: the lit lamp, the CO₂ value, and the chart bands. The freshness dot, the controls and the other values stay neutral. The one exception in the build is the warning triangle of an outdated reading, drawn in amber ink.

rules.name: The Two Schemes Rule
rules.body: Every colour exists in a light and a dark form with the same name. Light is the default; the system scheme applies until the visitor picks one with the theme button.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every number is set in tabular figures. A value that changes keeps its width.

rules.name: The Weight Pair Rule
rules.body: The build uses 400 and 700 only. Do not add a third weight for emphasis.

rules.name: The Flat Panel Rule
rules.body: Panels and controls have no shadow. Separation is tone (ground against panel) and hairlines.

dos: Do show the air state as exactly one lit lamp plus one sentence from the fixed vocabulary (Luft gut, Bald lüften, Jetzt lüften / Air is fine, Air the room soon, Air the room now).
Do use the CO₂ limits 800 and 1000 ppm everywhere a state colour appears.
Do set every number in tabular Lexend and keep value cells at a fixed width.
Do dash simulated data: the source tag outline and every chart line.
Do show how current every value is, and mark outdated values in muted slate with the warning triangle.
Do read chart colours from the CSS variables, so both schemes apply.
donts: Don't use green, amber or red for anything other than the air state: not for controls, links, the freshness dot or decoration.
Don't add shadows to panels or controls; the lamp halo is the only shadow.
Don't replace the lamp with a KPI tile, a gauge or a sparkline.
Don't show a missing value as zero; show an en dash and a gap in the chart.
Don't add a font weight beyond 400 and 700, or a second typeface.
